items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: we did a jam session out there on, you know, how the heck was -- I've got a picture of Buddy Rich, and all that sort of thing. And Stuff Smith playing, and his violin, and oh, it was really nice.

ctx.x: Yeah, you see, so -- and Johnny Buggs was there. They going to have -- he was scared to look me in the face, because of a lot of reasons, because I knew him backwards, and anyway, well, we won't go into that.

And so I went out to Hollywood, in the Trouville Club. Bergs Trouville Club, with Stuff Smith, and Buddy Rich, and all of us, did a jam session out there on, you know, how the heck was -- I've got a picture of Buddy Rich, and all that sort of thing. And Stuff Smith playing, and his violin, and oh, it was really nice. You know.
